notes.title: Sound Effect Overhaul and Buffing Update!
notes.notes:
Welcome monster slayers! 

This update includes two things players have been asking for - sounds and buffs!

First off, when you're rolling the dice, they'll bounce off each other and make sounds. When you hit, each type of attack will make a different sound. These sound effects should hopefully help to bring your battles to life a bit more!

Second, we've buffed the Warrior and Rogue classes in a few ways. They now start with more actions: the warrior will start with his "shield bash" and the rogue will start with his "archery" action. In addition, they'll both start off with more AP so you can do more each turn right off the bat!

A few actions have also been buffed, encouraging players to try out more actions and make more decisions in battle.

We really hope you're enjoying Two Die, and please leave us comments either in our Discord or Community page! 

Thanks once again!
Jon

notes.title: Class and Upgrade rebalancing, bug fixes
notes.notes:
Just a quick release:
[list]
[*] Rogue now starts with the "Archery" action
[*] Warrior now starts with the "Shield Bash" action
[*] Rogue starts with one less Speed
[*] Warrior starts with one less Defense
[*] Mage starts with two less AP
[*] Bolt Potion now only grants double speed at the beginning of each encounter
[*] Distilled Energy is a new upgrade that grants double AP at the beginning of each encounter (which used to come with Bolt Potion, just seemed too strong in practice )
[*] Bug Fix: Enemies no longer can use ranged attacks through objects
[*] Bug Fix: Players can no longer skip through dice rolling state due to lots of little bugs popping up around that. Dice roll state has been made quicker in response to this. 
[/list]

Hope you all are enjoying the game! Let me know what you think our our updates!

notes.title: Achievement Update!
notes.notes:
Hey high rollers!

Two Die is getting a new update - this time we're integrating with Steam's achievement system! Sorry it took so long to get here, but now you'll get some validation for your accomplishments in Two Die! Make sure to update to the latest version to start unlocking all the achievements!

More updates will come out over time, keep giving us feedback on what you want to see in the game. Join us in our Discord or post on the game's community page with your thoughts! 

Thanks again!
Jon

notes.title: Upgrades, Enemies, and Control Remapping Update!
notes.notes:
Hey killers!

Two Die is getting it's biggest update yet! This time, we've added a lot of different things.

First, we've added a number of new upgrades:
[list]
[*] Bolt Potion - Start the first turn of each encounter with double your maximum AP and speed
[*] Cookie - ???
[*] Coin of Death - Regain 10 HP instead of dying next time HP reaches 0
[*] Lost Key - Snake Eye rolls no longer cost double AP
[*] Luck Key - Critical Hit on 11 Dice Rolls
[*] Red Skull - Killing enemies grants +2 AP this turn
[/list]

Next, look forward to seeing these new enemies:
[list]
[*] Brain
[*] Spirit
[*] Water Elemental
[/list]

Another new feature - some of the stronger enemies now have different dice colors when they attack you. Watch out for these... 

We've had several suggestions on things to change, so these new features directly address player input:

One of our players mentioned in a review that they wished they could remap the controls. This update now allows you to completely remap the keyboard controls! Great suggestion, thanks for the idea.

We also had a recommendation to allow additional skipping through the Dice Rolling screen - you can now continue to press enter or click through to skip as early as you'd like. 

Before, when the player was low health, the screen turned so red that it was hard to see where the enemies would be moving. We've lowered that effect some so it should be more clear what is happening.

If you have thoughts or ideas on Two Die, please join us on Discord (click the link from Two Die's main menu!) and let us know, we're still listening and updating based on your feedback.

There will be more updates in the future, so stick around. 

Thanks again!
Jon

notes.title: Critical/Snake Eyes Update!
notes.notes:
Back again for another update!

This time, we've added the following:
[list]
[*] When either a hero or an enemy roll two sixes, they get the AP for that attack back to use again in their current turn.
[*] When either a hero or an enemy roll two ones, that attack will cost double the AP.
[*] The Warrior's "Sword" upgrade path has been buffed - specifically "Steel Thrust" and "Brutal Strike". Using these actions will now buff your strength and/or accuracy, making aggressive play much more rewarding! 
[/list]

I really hope you're enjoying Two Die, and please reach out to me if you have any ideas for the game. 

Thanks!
Jon

notes.title: Two Die's First Update!
notes.notes:
Hey warriors, rogues, and mages! 

Thanks for playing the game and your interest in it! This is the first update to Two Die, and it's all based on player feedback. We had a (very little) launch party for the game, and some awesome recommendations were given. Based on that, the following changes have been made:
[list]
[*] When in the dice rolling state, the attacker's damage statistic is now shown.
[*] Quake now costs 3 AP rather than 4.
[/list]
The change to add the attacker's damage was designed to help players understand that when enemies inflict the "weak" status on them, their damage has been lowered. Without this present, sometimes players might suspect the algorithm for the dice rolls is off! It has the added benefit of helping you know which enemies are especially hard hitters. 

Players upgrading the mage noticed that...well, there really wasn't any reason to use the "quake" action rather than two "rock bash" actions. To address this, "quake" cost less and is easier to use! 

If you have any thoughts on the game, I'd love to hear them!

Thanks!
Jon
